mechanic.summary: A sustained beam damages players and permanently liquefies dormant Lightspawn Lashers into slowing hazards.
mechanic.response: Aim the beam through all dormant lasher corpses while other players leave its path; place resulting Lightsap away from future movement lanes.

provenance.description: Compact tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Blinding Vale guide and linked spell record.
